The bear likes the tiger.

Sees($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x see y?
Likes($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x like y?
Round($x, bool) ::: Is x round?
Red($x, bool) ::: Is x red?
Nice($x, bool) ::: Is x nice?

Needs(Bear, Rabbit, True) ::: The bear needs the rabbit.
Sees(Bear, Rabbit, True) ::: The bear sees the rabbit.
Likes(Mouse, Tiger, True) ::: The mouse likes the tiger.
Needs(Mouse, Rabbit, True) ::: The mouse needs the rabbit.
Sees(Mouse, Rabbit, True) ::: The mouse sees the rabbit.
Sees(Mouse, Tiger, True) ::: The mouse sees the tiger.
Round(Rabbit, True) ::: The rabbit is round.
Likes(Rabbit, Tiger, True) ::: The rabbit likes the tiger.
Needs(Rabbit, Tiger, True) ::: The rabbit needs the tiger.
Red(Tiger, True) ::: The tiger is red.
Likes(Tiger, Mouse, True) ::: The tiger likes the mouse.

Rules:
Sees($x, Mouse, True) && Likes($x, Mouse, True) >>> Sees($x, Bear, True) ::: If something sees the mouse and it likes the mouse then it sees the bear.
Needs($x, Tiger, True) >>> Likes($x, Mouse, True) ::: If something needs the tiger then it likes the mouse.
Red($x, True) >>> Likes($x, Mouse, True) ::: If something is red then it likes the mouse.
Likes($x, Mouse, True) >>> Sees($x, Mouse, True) ::: If something likes the mouse then it sees the mouse.
Needs($x, Mouse, True) >>> Sees(Mouse, Tiger, True) ::: If something needs the mouse then the mouse sees the tiger.
Nice(Rabbit, True) >>> Likes(Rabbit, Bear, True) ::: If the rabbit is nice then the rabbit likes the bear.
Big($x, True) && Nice($x, True) >>> Needs($x, Bear, True) ::: If something is big and nice then it needs the bear.
Round($x, True) && Sees($x, Bear, True) >>> Likes(Bear, Mouse, True) ::: If something is round and it sees the bear then the bear likes the mouse.
Likes($x, Rabbit, True) && Needs(Rabbit, Tiger, True) >>> Likes(Tiger, Rabbit, True) ::: If something likes the rabbit and the rabbit needs the tiger then the tiger likes the rabbit.

Query:
Likes(Bear, Tiger, True) ::: The bear likes the tiger.
